articles.title: Mass. to be 4th state to roll out EBT chip cards to curb fraud
articles.description:
The state will begin distributing new chip-enabled EBT cards to combat benefit theft. Here's what recipients and retailers should know.

The post Mass. to be 4th state to roll out EBT chip cards to curb fraud appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Massachusetts will distribute new chip-enabled EBT cards starting August 2026.
State aims to reduce benefit theft as the 4th state to implement this system.
New cards will enhance security for over 1 million EBT recipients in Boston.
